stem: Fresh transplants occupy only a small portion of a much larger container, and large irrigation events keep the unrooted lower media wet for long periods. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: Increase fertilizer strength because a small root system needs a higher nutrient concentration to support expansion
Keep the full container near saturation so roots can grow into consistently wet media without moisture gradients
Match irrigation to current root occupancy, media behavior, and measured depletion rather than mature demand
Increase light intensity so the canopy removes water faster from the unrooted lower portion of the container
rationale: Young root systems may not use water throughout the full container volume. Irrigation should reflect current root occupancy and measured root-zone behavior rather than assuming mature demand immediately after transplant.
